name: Art Deco Marquee
summary: A 1930s premiere: sunbursts, stepped gold frames and an elevator dial whose coral needle swings to −18%.
look: Lacquered deep teal-black fields, amber gold hairlines, ray fans and ziggurat frames, Instrument Serif display with widely tracked light Manrope caps. Coral appears only on the needle, the number and the CTA.

components.name: Sunburst
components.role: alternating gold ray fans (7–14 % opacity) from a focal point

components.name: Stepped frame
components.role: ziggurat-cornered gold border, doubled with a hairline

components.name: Medallion
components.role: double-ringed circle holding a hero number or the mark

components.name: Floor-indicator dial
components.role: semicircular gauge with a teal safe zone and a coral needle

components.name: Stepped plaque
components.role: notched-corner button in gold or coral, tracked caps

components.name: Marquee bulbs
components.role: chasing lights around the CTA frame

motion.name: Sunburst bloom
motion.how: rays scale 0→1 from the focal point, expo.out 0.75 s (1.5 beats), slow 2°/s rotation afterwards

motion.name: Needle swing
motion.how: rotation 0→−54° with elastic.out(1, .5) 0.9 s; the overshoot peak lands on the downbeat

motion.name: Bulb chase
motion.how: every third bulb dims, pattern shifts by one bulb per 16th note (0.125 s at 120 BPM)

story: Hook: a stepped gold frame with a "38" medallion asks how many dashboards you checked today. Reveal: a 360° sunburst blooms behind the Acme mark and ACME PULSE letter-spaces between double rules. Proof: an Art Deco floor-indicator dial for checkout conversion swings its coral needle to −18% (since 09:42, after deploy #2231) and a human presses the gold ROLL BACK plaque. CTA: "Caught before customers noticed." inside a chasing marquee with a START FREE plaque.
adapt: Put your hero metric on the dial and your product's action on the plaque; the sunburst can radiate from your logo or from whatever your product produces. Works best for launches, anniversaries and premium tiers.

references.note: Cassandre's Deco posters (Nord Express, Normandie) and the Peignot face

fit.risk: Gold ornament can feel like casino or hotel branding; thin tracked caps get small on phones.
